'''Pomelo''' is one of the many genera of [[tree]]s found above ground. Like the vast majority of above ground trees, pomelo [[wood]] is brown and produces brown products.

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] pomelo trees for their ''fruit''.
